about.visionDesc: To become a leading technology ecosystem where hardware and software solutions converge. We aspire to build a limitless shopping platform that shapes trends and technology standards for the future.
about.missionDesc: Deliver high-quality technology products with transparent sourcing and excellent after-sales service. Electro Store is committed to accompanying customers on their digital journey, optimizing life through technology.

faq.title: Support Center
faq.contactDesc: Our technical team is ready to assist you 24/7.

items.a: Typically, delivery in inner-city areas takes 1-2 business days. For other provinces, shipping takes 3-5 business days depending on the carrier.
All genuine products are warranted for 12 to 24 months per manufacturer standards. You can bring your device to any Electro Store location for warranty support.
We support COD, credit/debit cards, bank transfer, and popular e-wallets such as MoMo, ZaloPay, and VNPay.

terms.title: Terms & Policies
terms.subtitle: Electro Store is committed to protecting customer rights with transparent, clear policies that fully comply with applicable laws.
terms.privacyIntro: Your privacy is our top priority at Electro Store. We are committed to protecting your personal information with the highest security.
terms.privacyP1: We only collect your information when you create an account, place an order, or subscribe to our newsletter. Main purposes include:
terms.privacyL2: Providing technical support and after-sales service.
terms.privacyL3: Sending promotional notifications (only with your consent).
terms.privacyP2: Electro Store never buys, sells, or exchanges customer information with third parties for commercial purposes. All payment transactions are encrypted to international SSL standards.
terms.returnsIntro: Shop with confidence thanks to our transparent return policy that maximizes your rights when unexpected issues occur.
terms.returnsL1: Products with manufacturer defects (hardware, motherboard issues, etc.).
terms.returnsL2: Unused products with original seals, box, and full accessories.
terms.returnsL3: Return requests within 30 days of receipt.
terms.returnsP1: We do not accept returns for: drops or dents from use; water damage (except water-resistant devices); or unauthorized OS modifications (Root/Jailbreak).
terms.warrantyP1: All electronics purchased at Electro Store carry 12 to 24 months genuine warranty depending on category. Accessories (cables, chargers, cases) are warranted for 3-6 months.
terms.warrantyP2: Bring your device to any Electro Store showroom nationwide. Our technicians will inspect and respond within 24 hours. If sent to the manufacturer, processing takes up to 15 business days.
terms.shippingP1: Free shipping for orders from 500,000 VND. Below that, a flat 30,000 VND fee applies nationwide.
terms.shippingL1: Ho Chi Minh City & Hanoi inner districts: Express delivery within 2 hours.
